scope: This cost-correction task: inspection, exact price calculations, record and usage updates, validation, publication and reporting. Earlier completed tasks and later follow-ups excluded.

measurement.method: Ending cumulative counters minus starting cumulative counters; cumulative snapshots are never summed

projected_estimate.assumptions: Read archived records, revise documentation, verify arithmetic/manifests and publish. No model implementation or Ollama calls.

combined_total_label: Sum across providers for this cost-correction task; not a monetary cost. Original completed archival usage is separate.
missing_usage: Final response and work after latest token_count pending.
recovery: On next user message run work/update_cost_usage.py before answering; only the original record-update turn is measured, excluding follow-up usage.
